hypotheses: The owner can switch on a standing choice that the independent evaluator checks every proof, and switch it back. While it is on, no loop asks the proof-evaluator pick question, a proof's evaluator pick needs no answer of the loop, and iaso runs the evaluator for each delivered proof at the end of a build and at landing. Only the owner switches it: in their own terminal (iaso config evaluator always|ask) or by typing /iaso evaluator always|ask; an agent's command, or a config file, switches nothing. Off is the earlier rule: the evaluator is offered at each proof question.

given the owner switched the standing evaluator choice on, when an intent loop reaches its proof question for a requirement, then the question does not offer the evaluator as a pick, and the evaluator checks the proof when it is shown working
given the standing choice is on and the owner answered no proof question in this loop, when the agent records the evaluator for a proof, then it is accepted, without an answer of the loop
given the standing choice was never switched on, or the owner switched it back, when the agent records the evaluator for a proof the owner did not pick in this loop, then it is refused, as before
given the standing choice is on, when a proof agreed as shown after landing has landed, then the evaluator checks it and the owner is not asked
given an agent runs iaso config evaluator always, or edits config.yaml to say so, when iaso reads the choice, then the choice stays as the owner left it
given the standing choice is on, when the owner types /iaso evaluator ask, then the evaluator is offered at each proof question again
